title: Beyond the Screen
description: Nina disconnects from social media comparison and rediscovers present-moment peace in her everyday life.

scenes.narration: Nina spent every evening scrolling through curated lives on her phone, feeling increasingly invisible and exhausted by comparison.
scenes.visual: Young woman lying on a couch in a dark room illuminated only by her glowing phone screen

scenes.narration: Tonight, she placed the phone in a drawer, locked it, and stepped away. She decided to return to her real life.
scenes.visual: Hand placing a dark smartphone into a wooden desk drawer and sliding it shut

scenes.narration: She dusted off her old acoustic guitar resting in the corner. Her fingertips were rusty, but the chords resonated deeply through her quiet room.
scenes.visual: Woman holding an acoustic guitar near an armchair in a cozy living room lit by a floor lamp

scenes.narration: She brewed herbal tea, listening to the gentle hum of the kettle and watching rain wash against her window. She was truly present.
scenes.visual: Hands wrapping around a warm ceramic mug near a raindrops-covered window pane

scenes.narration: The next afternoon, she met her oldest friend in a park without checking her phone once. Their laughter was deep, real, and uninterrupted.
scenes.visual: Two female friends laughing together on a park bench surrounded by green autumn trees

scenes.narration: Nina realized that peace was not found in digital validation, but in living fully right where she stood.
scenes.visual: Woman sitting peacefully outdoors on a wooden bench taking a deep breath with eyes closed

scenes.narration: Disconnecting from the noise allows you to reconnect with yourself. Follow along for daily inspiration and quiet reflection.
scenes.visual: Serene portrait of a young woman resting outdoors in a sunlit field with a calm smile

character_reference: A young woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, wearing a loose-fitting cream-colored cable knit sweater and simple dark denim jeans, distinguished by small gold hoop earrings and a faint horizontal scar on her left wrist.
